fields.quoted_span: Any additional yearly security deposit increase may not exceed 10% of the current security deposit.
fields.note: The cap, pet deposit and prepaid rent rule, 2.5x at inception, trust and no commingling, interest-bearing account, 10-or-more-unit money market option, notice, 7% offset, 30-day return, 5- and 15-business-day deadlines and double damages all appear in the guide. The phrase on how deductions are sent is ambiguous. The guide says the itemized list goes by registered or certified mail, while personal delivery applies to returning the money.

fields.quoted_span: Any additional yearly security deposit increase may not exceed 10% of the current security deposit.
fields.note: The 1.5x cap, 2.5x at lease start, 10% yearly increase, 30-day return and double damages are all stated in the guide.
The field is empty and the guide states no effective date for the law.

fields.quoted_span: Within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy, a landlord must return the security deposit
fields.note: The guide presents the law in the present tense as current, with no repeal or sunset mentioned.

fields.quoted_span: The exception is an owner-occupied two-, or three-family dwelling.
fields.note: The guide also supports the written-request opt-in 30 days after sending, the application to mobile homes, and the seasonal exclusion from the investment section (not more than 125 consecutive days, permanent residence elsewhere).

fields.quoted_span: one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 )
fields.note: The guide cites 46:8-21.2 for the cap. It cites the aliases (-19, -19.1, -21, -21.1, -21.4, -21.5, -25, -26) for other provisions.
